title: UserProfile.id documented as opaque (never parse or interpret)
description: Lines 36-37 document that id is opaque: 'never parse it as email or assume a format. It is a stable key... Store and compare; do not interpret.' This is critical guidance: Tailscale Inc. uses numeric IDs, Headscale uses UUIDs or custom formats. Code that parses or assumes a format will break on other deployments. The docstring makes this explicit. Keep and enforce this rule.
